solver_implementation.primary: integer-scaled maximum-weight closure transformed to s-t max-flow using scipy.sparse.csgraph.maximum_flow
solver_implementation.scale: 10! so every Shapley objective coefficient is integer

key_observations: The deterministic monotonicity upper bound produced zero false certifications in the 1000-seed holdout, as expected from its construction under the monotone exact-oracle assumption.
At 896 unique coalition calls it certified phi<=0.005 for 62.2% of player-8 seeds and 61.9% of player-9 seeds; the v0 per-stratum Bonferroni bound certified none at any checkpoint.
At 896 calls it certified the tighter phi<=0.001 for only 6.3% and 6.1%; most seeds still required exact completion at 1024 calls.
At 768 calls epsilon=0.005 certification was 16.4%/16.2%; at 640 calls 1.6%/1.7%.

This holdout confirms value in exploiting monotonicity/partial-order structure for safe certification, but only on the same fixed 10-player game; an independent-game generalization protocol is still needed.

scope.certifier_assumptions: exact binary oracle values and monotonicity over the full Boolean lattice
scope.not_claimed: No guarantee for nonmonotone games, noisy oracles, approximate solver outputs, or independent unseen game families.
scope.comparison_note: v1 was durably preregistered and read back before seeds 1000..1999 were run unchanged.
